neighbours.label: the noun naming the factor in an explanation of a difference ('because electricity is so versatile', 'on the horizon than when high')
fire: Trucks are moving away from diesel because electricity is so cheap there.
Stars look dimmer when they are on the horizon than when overhead.
Homes heat with gas instead of coal because gas is so clean.
The planet looks larger when it is near the horizon than at noon.
Builders prefer bamboo to timber because bamboo is so light.
Wages are lower partly because of the lower cost of housing in Kentucky.
Many towns switched to solar rather than oil because sunlight is so plentiful.
Salaries differ in part because of the smaller tax burden in Alabama.
quiet: Trucks are moving away from diesel because they are so costly there.
Stars look dimmer when they are low than when they are high.
Homes heat with gas instead of coal because it is so clean.
The planet was named by a farmer in the last century.
Builders prefer bamboo to timber because it is so light.
Wages are lower partly because they were cut last year in Kentucky.
Many towns switched to solar rather than oil because they are so sunny.
Salaries are listed on page two of the report from Alabama.

notes: Top examples have no common token. Probes: 'because electricity' 0.23-0.82, 'on the horizon than' 0.68, 'because steel' 0.18; the same nouns outside an explanation are low ('needs electricity' 0.004, 'below the horizon' 0.01). Near misses keep the comparison and use a pronoun in place of the noun.
